author: Esed1
quote: I bought GTA 6 to escape the monotony of life. Instead, Rockstar sold it back to **** game is obsessed with realism at the expense of fun. One crash totals my car. The roads are clogged with traffic. I do not want a commute, I want an arcade playground where driving is fast, silly and forgiving.Then there are the chores. I have fixed a sink and done up a house. If I wanted that, I would not have bought a **** story was sold as Bonnie and Clyde, but Jason is a boring yes man with nothing of his own to say. The pairing has no spark because only one half of it has a personality.Combat fares no better. Full auto weapons bolted onto RDR2 style gunplay simply do not work, because the accuracy penalty makes aiming close to impossible.I reached chapter 4 in three days, pushing through just to finish and move on. I gave up.I will wait for Online, and hope it does not make me garden or restrict my crime in a make believe world.
